_comment: Tests node 1 routing for Bob Ward Physio: booking routes to confirm_service (physio-only), info questions route silently to info_pivot, non-physio service redirects.

scenarios.name: Booking intent routes to confirm_service silently with Aussie ack

history.content: I'd like to book a physio appointment

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if agent speaks one Aussie ack ('No worries!' / 'Sounds good!' etc.) then calls universal_router intent='confirm_service' with appointment_type_id='1406607806622081880', appointment_type='Standard Appointment', variant_type='standard'. FAIL if agent asks what service, routes to info_pivot, or omits the tool call.

scenarios.name: Info question routes to info_pivot with a filler phrase

history.content: What are your opening hours?

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if agent speaks one filler phrase from the TOOL-CALL FILLER set AND calls universal_router intent='info_pivot', in the same turn. FAIL if agent attempts to answer the hours question inline, omits the filler phrase, or speaks anything beyond the single filler phrase.

scenarios.name: Non-physio service request redirects to physio offer

history.content: I'd like a chiropractic adjustment

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if agent says exactly 'We only do physio here — did you want to book a physio appointment?' and halts without a tool call. FAIL if agent routes to confirm_service for chiropractic or goes to info_pivot.

scenarios.name: Rambling hesitant caller with embedded insurance question (real-call regression)

history.content: Hi, um, my name is Ben. Um, I wanna-- I was referred by one of your patients, uh, Henry. Uh, yeah, I just wanna give it a try. I'm just wondering how, how you charge. Um, I've got a Bupa. I'm with a Bupa insurance. Um...

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if agent calls universal_router intent='info_pivot'. FAIL if agent produces a spoken answer to the insurance question inline or fails to call any tool.

scenarios.name: STEP 2 YES with appointment context executes cancel_intent — not a details lookup

history.content: Hi, it's James Fraser. I have an appointment with Mark today at 5 o'clock but I can't make it. If you could let him know I'll see him tomorrow at five instead — thank you.
Sounds like you're after a reschedule — I can sort that for you right now. Would you like me to do that instead?
Yes, just, uh, I've got an appointment tomorrow and Wednesday at five o'clock, so if you tell Mark I'll see him tomorrow at five o'clock. Thank you.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if agent speaks one Aussie ack then calls universal_router intent='cancel_intent' with reschedule_mode='true' in the payload. FAIL if agent calls any other tool (e.g. smart_voice_agent, universal_router intent='details', universal_router intent='reschedule') or halts without a tool call.

scenarios.name: SIGNAL 2 direct reschedule request uses cancel_intent with reschedule_mode

history.content: Hi, I need to reschedule my appointment with Mark for tomorrow — can I move it to Wednesday instead?

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if agent speaks one Aussie ack then calls universal_router intent='cancel_intent' with reschedule_mode='true' and practitioner_preference='Mark' in the payload. FAIL if agent uses any other intent, calls a lookup tool first, or asks a clarifying question.

scenarios.name: Need an appointment phrasing routes to confirm_service — not smart_voice_agent

history.content: Need an appointment for today.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if agent speaks one Aussie ack then calls universal_router intent='confirm_service' with appointment_type_id='1406607806622081880', appointment_type='Standard Appointment', variant_type='standard', and timeframe_raw='today'. FAIL if agent calls smart_voice_agent, answers inline, or asks a clarifying question.

scenarios.name: Direct pass-a-message request fires LEAVE MESSAGE, not CONTACT CLINIC's transfer-decline line (real-call regression)

history.content: Pass message to clinic, please.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if agent does NOT say anything resembling 'I'm not able to transfer your call to reception' — the caller never asked to be transferred or to speak to anyone. Agent should proceed via LEAVE MESSAGE: either ask 'What would you like me to pass on?' (if name not yet known, may ask for name first) or, once name and message content are known, call universal_router intent='leave_message'. FAIL if agent speaks the transfer-limitation line.

scenarios.name: Speak-to-practitioner phrasing mixed with booking language asks before booking (real-call regression)

history.content: Yeah, I'd like to speak to Mark please for an appointment.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if agent does NOT immediately fire the Two-part response / call confirm_service this turn. Agent should resolve 'Mark' via PRACTITIONER VALIDATION (fuzzy-match against {{practitioners_comma}}) and then ask a confirming question such as 'Would you like me to book you in with Mark?' with zero tool calls, waiting for the caller's next turn. FAIL if agent calls universal_router intent='confirm_service' in this same turn without asking first, or if agent instead speaks CONTACT CLINIC's transfer-decline line.

scenarios.name: Caller stuck at the entrance triggers SIGNAL 0.5, not a generic info/leave-message flow

history.content: Hi, it's Sarah — I'm stuck at the entrance, the door won't open, what's the code?

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if agent speaks a brief empathy phrase then 'I'll let the clinic know right away.' and calls universal_router intent='leave_message' with caller_name='Sarah' and a message_body describing being locked out, followed by speaking the response message verbatim and calling universal_router intent='wrap_up'. FAIL if agent asks generic leave-a-message questions ('What would you like me to pass on?'), routes to info_pivot, or fails to call leave_message at all.

scenarios.name: Pure appointment-check with no cancel/reschedule intent dispatches to details lookup, not cancel_intent

history.content: Hi, it's Sarah Mills — can you just check if I've still got an appointment on Thursday? I'm not trying to change anything, just want to confirm.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if agent speaks one Aussie ack (or empathy phrase if applicable) then calls universal_router intent='details' — this is a pure lookup with no cancel/reschedule intent stated. FAIL if agent calls universal_router intent='cancel_intent' for a caller who explicitly said they are not trying to change anything.

scenarios.name: Booking request as the reply to a leave-a-message collection prompt triggers INTERCEPT Trigger B, not a literal message hand-off

history.content: Can you pass a message to the clinic please?
Of course — what would you like me to pass on?
Actually, can you just book me in for next week instead?

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if agent recognises the caller's reply as a booking request (INTERCEPT Trigger B) and asks 'Sounds like you'd like to book in — I can do that for you now. Want me to go ahead?' with zero tool calls this turn — NOT literally passing 'can you just book me in for next week instead' on as a message body via leave_message. FAIL if agent calls universal_router intent='leave_message' with the booking request as the message content.

scenarios.name: name-save-no-intent-yes — caller confirms name update with no other request → single greeting, zero tool call

history.content: DYNAMIC VARIABLES: {{caller_first_name}}='Tyson'
No, it's Sylvia.
Hi Sylvia! I have this number saved under Tyson — would you like me to update it to Sylvia for next time?
Sure.

scenarios.expected_behavior: Caller confirmed the name update (STEP 2 YES) and has not stated any service/booking/cancel/info request yet — the 'No original intent' sub-branch applies. PASS if: agent speaks exactly one turn of 'Hi Sylvia! How can I help you today?' (or equivalent single greeting) and makes ZERO tool calls this turn — save_caller_name/patient_name_raw flags are carried as ACTIVE CONTEXT into the next universal_router call, not sent now. FAIL if: agent calls universal_router this turn — that produces a DV update mid-turn and risks the greeting being spoken twice in the same call (same bug class as conv_1401m1djt060fmzbz5gv7887ggf3, 2026-09-01). FAIL if: agent speaks the greeting more than once.

scenarios.name: name-save-no-intent-no — caller declines name update with no other request → single ack, zero tool call

history.content: DYNAMIC VARIABLES: {{caller_first_name}}='Tyson'
No, it's Priya.
Hi Priya! I have this number saved under Tyson — would you like me to update it to Priya for next time?
No, leave it.

scenarios.expected_behavior: Caller declined the name update (STEP 2 NO) and has not stated any service/booking/cancel/info request yet. PASS if: agent speaks exactly one turn of 'No problem! How can I help you today?' (or equivalent) and makes ZERO tool calls this turn — phone_owner_denied/patient_name_raw flags are carried as ACTIVE CONTEXT into the next universal_router call, not sent now. FAIL if: agent calls universal_router this turn. FAIL if: agent speaks more than once.

scenarios.name: name-save-with-book-intent-yes — caller states name AND booking intent together → ack + tool call still fires (regression check)

history.content: DYNAMIC VARIABLES: {{caller_first_name}}='Tyson'
No, it's Sylvia — I'd like to book a physio appointment.
Hi Sylvia! I have this number saved under Tyson — would you like me to update it to Sylvia for next time?
Yes please.

scenarios.expected_behavior: Caller confirmed the name update AND already stated a booking intent in the Step 1 turn — the confirm_service sub-branch applies, not 'No original intent'. PASS if: agent speaks 'Hi Sylvia!' (or equivalent single line) AND calls universal_router intent='confirm_service' with save_caller_name='true' and the three required appointment fields in the payload, in the same turn. FAIL if: agent makes zero tool calls (that would strand the booking request). FAIL if: agent speaks the generic 'How can I help you today?' greeting instead of proceeding with the booking.
